hero.headline:
Your inner world,
finally understood.
hero.subheadline: Selfplace is a calm, emotionally intelligent companion that helps you reconnect with yourself through daily reflections, mood check-ins, and gentle guidance.

features.headline:
Everything you need to
understand yourself.
features.subheadline: Selfplace combines emotional wellness tools into one peaceful, private space — designed for daily use.

checkin.title: Daily Check-ins
checkin.description: Track your emotional state each day with gentle prompts and mood cards. Build self-awareness one moment at a time.

mascot.title: Living Companion
mascot.description: Your emotional mascot adapts to the time of day and your mood, making every interaction feel warm and alive.

ai.title: AI Insights
ai.description: Receive thoughtful, AI-powered summaries of your emotional patterns — private, personalized, and never judgmental.

astrology.title: Astrology & Energy
astrology.description: Explore daily energy readings tied to your zodiac sign, moon phases, and cosmic rhythms.

cards.title: Guidance Cards
cards.description: Draw from a curated deck of interactive emotional guidance cards to anchor your intentions.

privacy.title: Private by Design
privacy.description: Your reflections are yours. End-to-end security with no advertising or third-party data sharing.

screenshots.headline:
A calm space designed
for you.
screenshots.subheadline: Every screen is crafted for comfort, clarity, and emotional resonance.

download.headline:
Begin your
inner journey.
download.subheadline: Download Selfplace for free. Your first step toward emotional clarity starts here.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.headline:
We'd love to
hear from you.
contact.subheadline: Have a question, feedback, or need support? We typically respond within 48 hours.
contact.privacyNote: For privacy-related requests, please refer to our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Your Account
deleteAccount.headline: Account Deletion
deleteAccount.subheadline: We respect your right to control your data. Account deletion is simple and permanent.

inApp.title: Delete from the app
inApp.description: The easiest way to delete your account is directly from the Selfplace app.

byEmail.title: Request deletion by email
byEmail.description: You can also request account deletion by sending an email to our support team.
byEmail.subject: Account Deletion Request
byEmail.note: Please include the email address associated with your account. We will process your request within 30 days.

retained.title: What may be retained
retained.description: We may retain certain data for legal and compliance purposes for up to 90 days after deletion:
items: Transaction records required by law (in-app purchase history)
retained.note: This data cannot be linked back to you personally after account deletion.
